result.title: DSFlow: A Neuro-Symbolic Data Workflow Agent with Statistical Diagnostic Guardrails
result.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Presented as a poster at AIAS+ 2026, San Francisco, California, USA
result.summary: Data science workflows often require tools that presume non-trivial technical knowledge. Large language models (LLMs) reduce this barrier, but a gap remains between flexible general-purpose agents and statistically controlled pipelines. We introduce DSFlow, a LangGraph-based neuro-symbolic data-agent platform that combines reusable, LLM-selected skills with deterministic diagnostic guardrails. Skills provide extensible task knowledge. Symbolic validation can accept a proposed method, request clarification or replanning, override an unsuitable method, or supply a safe fallback. Regression and clustering case studies illustrate how DSFlow uses diagnostic evidence to correct method choices and documents those decisions in auditable reports.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DSFlow，一个基于 LangGraph 的神经-符号数据分析智能体，将 LLM 选择的可复用技能与确定性统计学诊断护栏结合，由符号验证决定接受方法、要求澄清与重规划或强制安全回退，并用回归与聚类案例展示决策记录。
AI.relevance_reason: 其符号护栏在「采纳／重规划／回退」间做门控决策，可能为 LVR 中的答案验证、贡献分配与停止—重规划控制提供可供核查的线索；但该工作面向表格数据流程，无视觉输入或 latent 状态，联系属于机制类比。
